import cv2
import numpy as np


def training_pixels(images):
    return np.stack([cv2.resize(x, (20, 20)) for x in images]).astype(np.float32) / 255.0


def camera_pixels(gray_roi):
    binary = cv2.adaptiveThreshold(gray_roi, 255, cv2.ADAPTIVE_THRESH_GAUSSIAN_C,
                                   cv2.THRESH_BINARY_INV, 11, 2)
    thick = cv2.dilate(binary, np.ones((3, 3), np.uint8), iterations=1)
    return cv2.resize(thick, (20, 20)).astype(np.float32) / 255.0
